title: 第1章  同棺沉睡的女尸，竟是女帝！
content_zh:
“徒儿，你发毒誓！”
“徒儿谨遵师命，若有违背，五雷轰顶！”
“好！待为师死后，你要自封经脉，抱着这具女尸沉睡三年！”
“三年后，你将脱胎换骨，一飞冲天！”
“徒儿谨记！”
玄云子点头，含笑而终。
三年后。
“你是谁？你想干什么？”
陆烬睁开眼，懵了。
眼前怎么出现一个精赤条条的陌生女人？
自己也被扒光衣服，腿软腰子疼！
不会被她给强了吧？
猛甩头，回忆潮水般涌来。
三年前，他遵从师尊遗愿，自封经脉，抱着一具女尸，把自己埋进坟墓……
如今三年期限已至，干尸呢？
忽然他想到了什么！
诈尸？！画皮？！
“你……你是那具女尸？”
细思极恐！
自己不会真被一具女尸给强了吧？？？

而且三年间他都处于假死状态，一无所知，极有可能被偷吃了很多次！
朦胧的夜明珠下，女子容颜绝世，腰肢如柳，长发如瀑，肌肤透着莹白珠光，眼神勾魂夺魄，似魅魔神女，却冰寒若霜。
“该干的早干了，你紧张什么？”
声音宛若天宫风铃，飘渺若仙。
关键是，她没否认！
陆烬色厉内荏，双眼圆瞪。
也就是说，自己在棺椁中躺了三年，也被这女尸榨了三年？
造孽啊！
按理说，被如此绝美尤物夺了男儿身，他也不亏。
可这是在坟墓里，这美女还是女尸变的，这谁顶得住！
“你到底是谁？”
陆烬在黑暗中摸索着被撕成条的布料盖住隐私，大着胆子问。
“你师尊让你与我同眠，没告诉你本座是谁？”
陆烬摇头。
女子眯起眼眸，若有所思点了点头，旋即正色道：
“本座乃青莲女帝！”
威严之声宛若闷雷灌耳，女帝气质惶惶如神祇。
说话间，有衣物从陆烬手指纳戒中自动飞出，眨眼穿在她身上。
衣袍宽大，遮不住那白皙如玉的性感锁骨，可恰是如此，更让这绝美尤物透出一番倾世风情。
陆烬眼神复杂，无心欣赏同处一棺的女人，皱眉道：

“青莲女帝？没听说过…”
青莲女帝冷声道：
“万年前，本座独步宇宙洪荒未逢敌手，你这井底之蛙自是不知苍穹辽阔。”
陆烬满脸愕然，看来，这女人大有来头！
“那你怎么成了尸体？”
一句话差点让青莲女帝破防：
“你还没资格知道。”
青莲女帝柳眉微蹙，声音威严：
“三年来，你日夜用精元蕴养，才使得本座肉身逢春，神魂归位。”
“不过，本帝血肉之躯尚未完全恢复，一个月后你要继续奉上精元。”
“可以你现在的修为，所供精元质量过低，我要你一个月内，把修为提高到金丹境。”
“另外，本帝跌落这方大陆，神魂被这方天道法则压制，百日之内，你要为我找到破妄魂果。”
“不然，杀了你，我换人！”
声音威严霸道，不容半分反驳。
陆烬心脏颤抖，眉头倒竖：
完不成就杀人？好无情的女人！
而且……一个月晋升金丹境？
简直天方夜谭！
三年前他天资卓绝，距离金丹都差了临门一脚，现在凭他一个废物，根本不可能！
“女帝大人，你有所不知，我如今，已无法修炼！”

性命被威胁，陆烬只好如实交代：
“我被人陷害，废了丹田，连至尊骨都被人挖走了！”
青莲女帝皱眉：
“这么惨？你怎么混的？”
陆烬无奈道：
“曾经的我，也是万剑宗天骄，内门第一，地位直逼圣子！”
“可一切都在三年前那场魔窟之行中改写了！我被骗入绝境，面对妖魔本就胜算寥寥，又遭未婚妻背刺，她与万剑宗圣子狼狈为奸，联手废了我的丹田，挖了我的至尊骨！”
“最后我虽死里逃生，却失去了一身修为，根本无法修炼！”
“不光如此，那个贱人在得知我没死后，竟诬陷是我坑害了那些葬身魔窟的弟子！有圣子撑腰，导致宗门上下，人人欲杀我而后快！”
“若不是师尊护着，我早死了。”
“可奈何他老人家三年前大限降临，一命呜呼，临死前嘱咐我一定要抱着千年女尸，自封经脉，活埋三年，才能化险为夷。”
“如今的我，不过废物一个，恐难当大任。”
说到最后，陆烬无奈苦笑。
“废物？你就这么看待自己？”
青莲女帝斜乜他一眼，眼神带着不掩饰的鄙夷。
似是被这道眼神刺激到了，陆烬不甘道：
“须知少日拏云志，曾许人间第一流！若有可能，谁不想青云直上，斗破苍穹！”
青莲女帝眯了眯眼，冷声道：
“所以，你现在成了自甘堕落的废物？”
陆烬摇头，眸色坚定：

“大仇未报，岂能自甘堕落！但凡有一线生机，我必杀出一条血路，手刃仇敌！”
闻言，青莲女帝唇角微勾，“算你还有点骨气。”
旋即反问道：
“你以为，三年来一直都是本帝在利用你？”
“抱着本帝睡了三年，你不光得了本帝的身子，更得了天大造化！好好感受一下身体，再下定论不迟。”
闻言，陆烬这才察觉到，身体的确发生了变化，眸色一变：
“嗯？我的丹田……还有至尊骨……发生了什么？它们都恢复了？不对，这种强大的感觉，绝不是恢复，像是被神秘力量直接加持在身，我居然无法看透！”
青莲女帝道：
“你现在是个身怀遮天潜能的废物。”
陆烬满脸愕然，一时难以置信。
青莲女帝轻飘飘道：
“那帝霸琉璃骨，以及无尽吞噬丹田，太过霸道，以你现在的实力还无法驾驭，本座再送你一物，助你修行。”
说着，她张开嘴，竟吐出一个核桃大的袖珍棺椁。
“此物乃九绝天棺之一的葬天棺！本帝万年前纵横八荒，全凭此物！”
“如今你我双修三载，血脉交融，这葬天棺自然也默认你为主人。”
“你只需以蕴含灵气之物供之，葬天棺自会反哺于你，至于更高阶的用法，你自行摸索。”
“只是你修为尚浅，切勿冒进，以免遭遇神器反噬。”
“九绝天棺共有九座，分别为，葬天，窥天，吞天，啼天，孕天，魔天，囚天，佛天，不朽天棺！”
“其它八座天棺散落于诸天万界之中，下落不明，你如今已与九绝天棺有了关联，就必须在三十年内将其他八座找到，不然必会遭遇反噬！或者死，或者沦为棺奴！”
听到这，陆烬眉头皱紧。

青莲女帝却不管他，兀自说道：
“一个月后，本帝会准时找你！”
“最后再纠正你一个错误，本帝可不是什么千年干尸，而是七窍玲珑圣体！”
青莲女帝话音落下，身形竟是化作一道流光没入葬天棺内，那葬天棺也眨眼消失。
“嗯？”
陆烬一愣，下一秒就看到，葬天棺已经钻进了脑海泥丸宫！
他愣住了，眼神却闪烁着精光。
“青莲女帝！帝霸琉璃骨！无尽吞噬丹田！九绝天棺之一的葬天棺！尽是通天手段！”
“身怀如此造化，一个月时间踏入金丹境，应该不是玩笑……而且三十年内找齐九绝天棺，这倒是个漫长的挑战！”
“不过，我陆烬，接了！”
这个世界境界划分为：
淬体境，灵窍境，灵珠境，金丹境，紫府境，玄尊境，涅槃境……
三年前，他巅峰时期的修为乃是灵珠九重，距离金丹只差一步之遥，奈何一场变故让他彻底沦为废人。
如今有了机缘，他誓要逆势崛起，报仇雪恨！
安静心神，盘膝而坐，开始检查身体。
这一检查，他面色大变！
这具身体血脉强劲，俨然处于灵窍巅峰！
而且四肢百骸内，灵气运转的磅礴程度，强于寻常修士十倍不止！
“她果然没骗我！”
三年前他按师尊所说，利用秘法封印经脉，隐藏所有气息，让自己处于假死状态，躲过满宗追杀。

如今三年过去，当身体苏醒，他竟迈入了灵窍九境！
闭目内观，体内滚滚灵气运转周天，最后百川归海，汇入丹田！
“我的丹田！无尽吞噬？这也太霸道了！”
现在的丹田，比起之前巅峰时期的丹田，品质要高得多，简直云泥之别！
“丹田重塑！我又可以修炼了！”
“而且……帝霸琉璃骨？”
体内原本至尊骨生长的地方，赫然多出来一块琉璃玉骨！
“这块玉骨深不可测！我那被挖走的至尊骨，跟它比简直小巫见大巫！”
“原来女帝早已改造了我的血肉之躯！”
这一瞬，他热血沸腾！
青莲女帝修复了他的身体，为他重塑丹田，赐予稀世玉骨，更给了他葬天棺这等神物！
这是天大的恩情！
而且……
他还与如此绝世女帝有了纠缠不清的关系……
或许，这也是师尊临终前让他抱尸而眠的最终目的吧！
他忽然懂了老头的用心良苦。
“不过，师尊他老人家是怎么知道这道机缘的？”
回忆一阵却也无法知晓个中缘由，索性不再多想，而把注意力彻底放在身体上。
“这帝霸琉璃骨和无尽吞噬丹田好像被一股神秘力量笼罩着，我也只知道它们的存在，根本无法进一步探查…”
“而葬天棺却因与女帝的血脉交融，能初步动用……有如此宝物，一个月内，必踏入金丹之境，我陆烬，说到做到！”

一念至此，记忆中的一切再次翻滚闪现。
“柳如烟，杨巅峰！你们这俩贱人！”
“当初那一剑穿心之痛，挖骨夺髓之苦，我必百倍奉还！”

content_en:
"Disciple, you swore poison!"
"Disciple, please obey your master's orders. If you disobey, you will be struck with thunder!"
"Okay! After my master dies, you will seal your own meridians and sleep with this female corpse for three years!"
"In three years, you will be completely transformed and soar into the sky!"
"Disciple, remember this!"
Xuan Yunzi nodded and ended with a smile.
Three years later.
"Who are you? What do you want to do?"
Lu Jin opened his eyes and was stunned.
Why did a naked strange woman appear in front of me?
My clothes were also stripped off, my legs were weak and my waist hurt!
You won't be forced by her, right?
Shaking his head violently, memories came flooding back.
Three years ago, he followed his master's last wish, sealed his own meridians, held a female corpse, and buried himself in a grave...
Now that the three-year deadline has expired, where is the mummy?
Suddenly he thought of something!
Fake corpse? ! Painted skin? !
"You...are you the female corpse?"
It’s scary to think about it!
Isn't it true that I was raped by a female corpse? ? ?
Moreover, he has been in a state of suspended animation for three years, knowing nothing about it, and it is very likely that he has been eaten many times!
Under the hazy night pearl, the woman has a peerless appearance, with a waist like a willow, long hair like a waterfall, her skin is shining with white pearls, and her eyes are enchanting, like a succubus goddess, but as cold as frost.
"You have already done what you have to do. Why are you nervous?"
The sound is like a celestial wind chime, as ethereal as a fairy.
The key is, she didn't deny it!
Lu Jin's face turned sharp and his eyes widened.
In other words, he had been lying in the coffin for three years and was also exploited by this female corpse for three years?
What a sin!
Logically speaking, he would not be at a loss if he lost his manhood to such a beautiful creature.
But this is in a tomb, and this beauty is transformed into a female corpse. Who can withstand this!
"Who are you anyway?"
Lu Jin groped in the darkness for the torn strips of cloth to cover his privacy, and boldly asked.
"Your master asked you to sleep with me, but didn't tell you who I am?"
Lu Jin shook his head.
The woman narrowed her eyes, nodded thoughtfully, and then said seriously:
"I am Empress Qinglian!"
The majestic voice was like thunder piercing the ears, and the empress' temperament was as frightening as that of a god.
As she spoke, some clothes flew out of Lu Jin's finger ring and were put on her body in the blink of an eye.
The robe is too wide and cannot cover the sexy collarbone as white as jade, but it is exactly this that makes this stunning beauty reveal a world-class charm.
Lu Jin's eyes were complicated and he had no intention of admiring the woman in the same coffin. He frowned and said:
"Empress Qinglian? Never heard of it..."
Empress Qinglian said coldly:
"Ten thousand years ago, I was alone in the universe and had no rivals. You, the frog in the well, don't know how vast the sky is."
Lu Jin's face was full of astonishment. It seemed that this woman had a lot of background!
"Then why did you become a corpse?"
One sentence almost made Empress Qinglian break her guard:
"You're not qualified to know yet."
Empress Qinglian frowned slightly and spoke in a majestic voice:
"For the past three years, you have used your essence to nourish me day and night, so that my physical body can spring up and my soul can return to its original position."
"However, my flesh and blood body has not yet fully recovered. You must continue to offer essence in one month."
"It's okay that with your current cultivation level, the quality of the essence you provide is too low. I want you to raise your cultivation level to the golden elixir realm within a month."
"In addition, this emperor fell to this continent, and his soul was suppressed by the laws of heaven. Within a hundred days, you must find the Soul-breaking Fruit for me."
"Otherwise, I'll kill you and I'll replace you!"
The voice was majestic and domineering, not allowing for even the slightest refutation.
Lu Jin's heart trembled and his brows stood up:
Is it possible to kill someone? What a heartless woman!
And...promoted to the Golden Core Realm in one month?
It’s simply a fantasy!
Three years ago, he was so talented that he was just one step away from the golden elixir. Now, with him being a loser, it is impossible!
"My Lady Empress, you don't know something. Now, I can no longer practice!"
His life was threatened, so Lu Jin had no choice but to tell the truth:
"I was framed, my Dantian was destroyed, and even the Supreme Bone was poached!"
Empress Qinglian frowned:
"So miserable? How did you get away with it?"Lu Jin said helplessly:
"I used to be a genius of the Wanjian Sect, number one in the inner sect, and my status was as close to that of the Holy Son!"
"But everything changed during that trip to the Demon Cave three years ago! I was deceived into a desperate situation. I had little chance of winning against the demon, and I was stabbed in the back by my fiancée. She colluded with the Holy Son of the Wanjian Sect, and teamed up to destroy my Dantian and dig out my Supreme Bone!"
"Although I escaped death in the end, I lost all my cultivation and couldn't practice at all!"
"Not only that, when that bitch learned that I was alive, he actually framed me as the one who harmed the disciples who were buried in the Devil's Cave! With the support of the Holy Son, everyone in the sect wants to kill me and then hurry up!"
"If it weren't for Master's protection, I would have died long ago."
"But the old man's death came three years ago and he died. Before he died, he told me that I must hold the corpse of a thousand-year-old woman, seal my own meridians, and bury her alive for three years, so that I can avert danger."
"Now I am nothing more than a useless person. I may not be able to hold a big position."
At the end, Lu Jin smiled helplessly.
"Trash? Is this how you see yourself?"
Empress Qinglian glanced at him sideways, with undisguised disdain in her eyes.
Lu Jin seemed to be stimulated by this look, and said unwillingly:
"It should be noted that Shaolin Naoyunzhi once promised to be the best in the world! If possible, who wouldn't want to rise to the top and fight to break the sky!"
Empress Qinglian narrowed her eyes and said coldly:
"So, you are now a self-destructive waste?"
Lu Jin shook his head, his eyes firm:
"How can I surrender without revenge? As long as there is a glimmer of hope, I will fight my way out and kill the enemy with my own hands!"
Hearing this, Empress Qinglian's lips curled up slightly, "You still have some backbone."
He immediately asked:
"Do you think this emperor has been taking advantage of you for the past three years?"
"You have slept with me in your arms for three years. Not only have you gained my body, but you have also received great blessings from heaven! It's not too late to feel your body and make a final decision."
Hearing this, Lu Jin realized that his body had indeed changed, and his eyes changed:
"Huh? What happened to my Dantian...and Supreme Bone...? Have they all recovered? No, this powerful feeling is definitely not recovery. It's like being directly blessed by a mysterious force. I can't see through it!"
Empress Qinglian said:
"You are now a waste with the potential to overwhelm the heavens."
Lu Jin's face was filled with astonishment and he couldn't believe it for a moment.
Empress Qinglian said lightly:
"The Emperor's Domination Glazed Bones and the Endless Devouring Dantian are too overbearing and cannot be controlled with your current strength. I will give you another thing to help you practice."
As she spoke, she opened her mouth and spit out a pocket coffin the size of a walnut.
"This object is one of the nine unique heavenly burial coffins! This emperor traveled across the wilderness thousands of years ago, all because of this object!"
"Now that you and I have been cultivating for three years and have blended our bloodlines, this sky-burial coffin naturally acquiesces you as its master."
"You only need to provide it with something that contains spiritual energy, and the Sky Burial Coffin will feed you back. As for more advanced uses, you can explore on your own."
"It's just that your cultivation level is still shallow, so don't rush forward, lest you encounter backlash from the artifact."
"There are nine Nine Jue Heavenly Coffins, namely Burying Heaven, Peeping Heaven, Swallowing Heaven, Crying Heaven, Pregnant Heaven, Demon Heaven, Imprisoned Heaven, Buddha Heaven, and Immortal Heaven Coffin!"
"The other eight celestial coffins are scattered in the heavens and the world, and their whereabouts are unknown. Now that you are related to the Jiujue celestial coffins, you must find the other eight within thirty years, otherwise you will encounter backlash! Either die, or become a coffin slave!"
Hearing this, Lu Jin frowned.
Empress Qinglian ignored him and said to herself:
"In one month, I will find you on time!"
"One last mistake, I want to correct you. This emperor is not a thousand-year-old mummy, but an exquisite holy body with seven orifices!"
After the Qinglian Empress finished speaking, her figure turned into a stream of light and sank into the sky burial coffin, and the sky burial coffin also disappeared in the blink of an eye.
"Huh?"
Lu Jin was stunned, and the next second he saw that the Sky Burial Coffin had entered the Niwan Palace in his mind!
He was stunned, his eyesBut it sparkled.
"Empress Qinglian! Emperor's domineering glazed bones! Endlessly devouring Dantian! The Sky Burying Coffin, one of the Nine Ultimate Coffins! It's all a means to reach the heavens!"
"With such a good fortune, it should not be a joke to enter the Golden Core Realm in one month... And finding all the Nine Jue Heavenly Coffins within thirty years is indeed a long challenge!"
"But I, Lu Jin, took it!"
The realm of this world is divided into:
Tempering body realm, spiritual orifice realm, spiritual pearl realm, golden elixir realm, purple mansion realm, Xuanzun realm, nirvana realm...
Three years ago, when he was at his peak, he was at the ninth level of the Lingzhu level, only one step away from the golden elixir. However, an accident completely turned him into a useless person.
Now that he has the opportunity, he vows to buck the trend and take revenge!
Quiet your mind, sit cross-legged, and start checking your body.
After this inspection, his expression changed drastically!
This body's bloodline is strong, as if it is at the peak of its spiritual aperture!
Moreover, the majestic movement of spiritual energy within the limbs and bones is more than ten times stronger than that of ordinary monks!
"She really didn't lie to me!"
Three years ago, according to his master's instructions, he used a secret method to seal his meridians, hide all his breath, and put himself in a state of suspended animation to avoid being pursued by the Manchu sect.
Now three years later, when his body woke up, he actually entered the ninth realm of spiritual aperture!
Close your eyes and look inside, the spiritual energy rolling in your body circulates around the sky, and finally all the rivers return to the sea and merge into the Dantian!
"My Dantian! Endless devouring? This is too overbearing!"
The Dantian now is of much higher quality than the Dantian at its peak before. It’s a huge difference!
"The Dantian has been reshaped! I can practice again!"
"And...Emperor Glazed Bones?"
Where the Supreme Bone originally grew in the body, a piece of glazed jade bone suddenly appeared!
"This jade bone is unfathomable! My supreme bone that was dug away is nothing compared to it!"
"It turns out that the empress has already transformed my flesh and blood body!"
At this moment, his blood boiled!
Empress Qinglian repaired his body, reshaped his Dantian, gave him rare jade bones, and even gave him such divine objects as the Sky Burial Coffin!
This is a great kindness!
And...
He also had an entangled relationship with such a peerless empress...
Perhaps, this was also the ultimate purpose of Master letting him sleep with his body before his death!
He suddenly understood the old man's good intentions.
"But how did Master know about this opportunity?"
